title: Chapter 898
text:
Han Xiao frowned and read it carefully.

"This is the observation record and predicted coordinates of the [Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy] …"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

EsGod had been trying to master a Super High Risk Esper Ability for many years. One method was to combine the abilities of various Esper Abilities, and the other was to find the location of the Super High Risk Esper Ability.

In the Super High Risk Esper Ability Restriction Treaty, not all abilities originated from the self-awakening of life forms. There was a Super High Risk Esper Ability that was extremely rare and unique, called 'Primal Esper Ability Entities' or 'Possession Esper Ability Entities'. It was an Esper Ability lifeform that existed in the form of an energy field. It had its own independent thoughts and consciousness, and it was an extremely ancient existence that roamed the universe.

This Esper Ability allowed a lifeform to master its power in the form of possession. It was called a 'host'.

The selection criteria for a host were extremely strict. As long as the nature of their energy conflicted, no matter how strong the Super was, they would not be able to take on the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. Therefore, only Espers and ordinary people had the chance to become a host. If the host could not take on the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, there would be a backlash.

Lifeforms below Calamity Grade would not be able to take on the backlash and would explode in the physical sense.

If the possession succeeded, the host would be able to use the power of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. The host's Esper Ability came from external forces, and the host was like a launcher. The stronger the host was, the stronger the Esper Ability would be. The host would also consume energy to activate the Esper Ability, but the consumption rate was far lower than normal Espers. This type of Esper was extremely rare and was even stronger than the Awakened.

The [Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy] was one of the 'Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy'. It was a compound Esper Ability with many abilities. Physique strengthening, energy radiation, and super speed were all basic effects. It could also travel in secondary space and extract energy from a planet's core. At the same time, it had psychic and spatial attributes.

In history, there had been a few hosts of the [Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy], and they had left behind shocking deeds, making this ability enter the list of Super High Risk Esper Abilities.

In Han Xiao's previous life, the [Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy] was one of the Super High Risk Esper Abilities that EsGod had in the later versions. However, EsGod was not the host. Instead, he tore a fragment from the [Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy] and obtained a part of the 'Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy'.

This storyline was very interesting. It did not know if the fragment EsGod took away was its reproductive organ, but it wanted to snatch back that part of its' body '. Therefore, it took the initiative to find a host and let the host deal with EsGod.

Therefore, two people with [Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy] appeared at the same time, as if they were mortal enemies. This host was also an important character in EsGod's storyline.

The [Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy] shuttled through the secondary dimensions, occasionally appearing in various corners of the universe. This document recorded the observation report of the [Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy]'s movements, as well as the possible coordinates of its appearance in the universe at a certain point in the future.

"EsGod obtained this ability in the later versions, which means that one of the coordinates recorded in this document should be reliable."

Han Xiao rubbed his chin. He was a little tempted.

He could not use his Esper Ability himself, but he could use it to train his subordinates. Although there was the restriction of the Super High Risk Esper Ability Restriction Treaty, the specific implementation differed from person to person. With his current position, as long as he did not let his subordinates abuse their abilities, the three Universal Civilizations would not care about him. After all, where there were people, there were privileges.

As for the method to capture primitive energy entities, it was not a problem for a Mechanic at his level. All he had to do was build a containment device that could restrain energy life forms. Many civilizations had such technology.

"However, it's still early for the [Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy] to return from the secondary dimensions, so there's no need to rush."

Han Xiao nodded.

According to the data, there were still a few decades before the [Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy]'s next return. It was too early to prepare now, and it would be useless even if he went to those coordinates.

However, this time, it would not be as easy as obtaining the Spacetime Amber. Shazik was not the only organization that obtained this document. There would be other organizations that obtained EsGod's inheritance as well, so there would definitely be competitors.

I'll think about it when the time comes. Anyway, I'll just snatch it … Han Xiao did not mind.

With his current strength, he was not afraid of competing with other organizations at all, not to mention a few decades later. By then, he still did not know how strong the Black Star Corps would be.

Exiting the quantum network, Han Xiao's gaze fell on the two of them again. He nodded.

"I'm very satisfied with this gift. Shazik, I think you're very talented in intelligence. How about you develop in the army's intelligence department?"

"I'll accept any arrangement." Shazik did not object.

Han Xiao nodded. He felt that Shazik was a talent in intelligence, and he might be able to take charge of the intelligence department in the future.

Then, he turned to look at Lothaire, pondered for a while, and slowly said, "For you, I won't give you a chance.

"As for you … I won't give you a position for the time being. Just follow me for now."

This protagonist type character was very powerful. He planned to let Lothaire lead a secret team alone in the future and establish the Assassin Association … but now was not the time.

This guy had just joined, so he needed to observe him for a while.

"Okay."

Lothaire was a man of few words.

"Then, the two of you can go and rest first. Familiarize yourself with the headquarters."

The two of them nodded and left the room.

Han Xiao sat on the sofa and watched the two of them leave before standing up and leaving the guest room.

He went straight to the Army Commander's exclusive machinery factory and asked Philip to retrieve the information on the Evolutionary Civilization.

He had only roughly browsed through it earlier, and only now did he have the time to study it in depth.

The technology of the Evolutionary Civilization had been lost, and the information in EsGod's hands was also incomplete. It did not involve the principles of the Evolution Cube and was more like an operating manual.

After reading this information, Han Xiao realized that his method of using the Evolution Cube was very crude.

A Universal Treasure created by a quasi-Universal Civilization had many uses. The Evolutionary Civilization used it as a special energy source and developed various devices to target it. This information recorded several devices specifically used for the Evolution Cube.

For example, there was a totem device that used the energy of the Evolution Cube as fuel. Its range of influence could be adjusted and could cover an entire planet at most. Different from the one-time enhancement of the Evolution Cube, the effect of the totem device was more gentle. It was similar to a halo buff. If maintained for a long time, it could slowly increase the talent and potential of the creatures on a planet, causing the awakening rate of the Supers on that planet to soar. It was equivalent to transforming a planet into a paradise, and the newborns would become stronger.

There was only one Evolution Cube, but he could create as many totem devices as he wanted. They could be used as long as they were charged. In the past, the Evolutionary Civilization had used the totem device to increase the talent of the entire civilization. The efficiency was very high, and the results were controllable.

"This is good stuff!" Han Xiao's eyes shone with the light of money.

With such a totem device, the attractiveness of the Evolution Cube to the various civilizations increased by many times. Its commercial value and the value of connections were immeasurable.

This was also useful to the Black Star Corps. They could use it to slowly strengthen the planets where the various bases were located, greatly increasing the explosive rate of the training camps.

There was also a device that could be worn at all times in the information called the 'Ovitan Badge'. It also used the Evolution Energy as fuel, and after activation, it could allow the wearer to undergo extreme evolution regardless of the consequences. It could turn an ordinary person into a biological mutant, and their combat power would reach Grade C or even Grade B. The effect was more powerful than any berserk type drugs, and the duration ranged from a few hours to a few days. After the effect ended, the wearer would die due to genetic breakdown.

It was also possible for a perfect Evolver to directly break through the gene lock, but the probability was so small that it could be ignored.

Only in the face of a great crisis would the Evolutionary Civilization use such a method with serious side effects.

The side effects of the Ovitan Badge were too great, and Han Xiao immediately thought of the perfect user — the players!

The army's nuclear backpack had always been a popular product, and the players would most likely not mind the side effects of the Ovitan Badge.

"With this, the death-seeking style is going to be popular again."

In the future, when the army players went out to fight, all of them would be able to transform into ugly mutants. Perhaps others would think that he was experimenting on the soldiers of the army, and he would be considered to be from the evil faction.

There were other ways to use this effect. EsGod's information recorded an offensive method, which was a special ground-to-ground missile that carried the Evolution Energy similar to the effect of the Ovitan Badge. After hitting the surface, the Evolution Energy would spread out, and the range would be tens of kilometers. All creatures contaminated by the Evolution Energy would become mutants, and their lives would enter the countdown of despair.

The Evolutionary Civilization only needed to wait for their genes to collapse and die, and they would be able to easily take over the enemy's territory without damaging the buildings on the surface. It was like a biological weapon that could accurately kill creatures.

"What a terrifying weapon." Han Xiao raised his brows. The Evolutionary Civilization had probably used this weapon many times during the exploration era.

At the end of this information, there were also various techniques to establish a Soul Connection with the Evolution Cube. In the words of the Evolutionary Civilization, it was called 'resonance'.

The Evolutionary Civilization would not put away the Universal Treasures they created but would make the best use of them. Every Civilization Guardian had to establish a Soul Connection with the Evolution Cube. This was a technique passed down from generation to generation.

"This makes things convenient for me." Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

Sisko's Soul Connection with the Evolution Cube had been removed, and the slot was empty.

Having another Soul Connection with a Universal Treasure would also increase his strength.

Speaking of which, this Evolution Cube had gone through who knew how many owners, and it was already a withered flower.

The Spacetime Amber was still the best. It gave him the first time.

Han Xiao hurriedly shook his head and threw these weird thoughts out of his mind.

"I finally have work to do. Let's mass produce these devices first."
